coordination_holds_append: This owner-requested option does not supersede PB b29, modify D-071 or close D-024/CF-006. Promote it only after the owner confirms the preferred island length and opposite-side dining relationship and a new decision records the departure from D-071's beside-kitchen dining position.
The 7.20 m island uses the practical clear span between 1.40 m and 1.90 m end routes; a literal 10.50 m wall-to-wall island would obstruct circulation to the pantry/Great Wall and is not recommended.
Keep water, drainage and cooking extraction on the Side A wall and treat the island as dry prep/seating to avoid avoidable slab penetrations, service loops and maintenance risk.

The opposite dining table remains outside the Y=7.00–11.00 m pedestrian axis and clear of the bathroom and homelab doors, but its longer serving route should be accepted only with daily island seating and a mobile serving trolley.
Site orientation, dining-side daylight/opening, P2 facade alignment, real appliance schedule, extract route, lighting, power and detailed joinery remain open professional design gates.
